_comment: Hand-curated manifest of the ~14 schools wpr-prep-sports tracks. The scraper reads this to know which schools to fetch. `wiaa_org_id` is stable across seasons; per-sport TeamIDs are minted yearly and re-discovered at scrape time. Run `python -m scraper.discover` to backfill nulls. Bound team slugs added 2026-05-23 for season-stats fetches.
